chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Jarrah Al-Madainy, from Abu

Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: When one of you rises at night, let him say: 'Glorious is the Lord of the Prophets and the God of the Messengers, and the Lord of the weak, and the Praise is for Allah Who revives the dead, and He is Able over all things.'
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'My servant has spoken the truth and has given thanks.'

key_terms.سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ النَّبِيِّينَ: Glorious is the Lord of the Prophets
key_terms.صَدَقَ عَبْدِي: My servant has spoken the truth

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite when waking up at night?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in Al-Kafi highlights the spiritual etiquette of waking, linking the believer's morning remembrance to the divine attribute of reviving the dead, a theme resonant with the Resurrection. The phrase 'The Lord of the Weak' (Rabb al-Mustad'afin) carries particular significance in Shia theology, connecting daily gratitude to the ultimate victory of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Mahdi over the oppressed. The divine response 'My servant has spoken the truth' underscores the authenticity of this specific dhikr as a means of securing Allah's pleasure and acknowledgment.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Jarrah Al Madainy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Whenever one of you stands (to pray Salāt) at night, so let him say, ‘Glorious is the Lordazwj of the Prophetsas and God of the Mursil (Prophetsas), and Lordazwj of the weak ones, and the Praise is for Allahazwj Who Revives the dead and Heazwj is Able upon everything’.
Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would be Saying: “My<sup>azwj</sup> servant speaks the truth and is grateful”’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa’Id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman from Jarrah al-Mada’Ini from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“When one of you wakes up during the night and says, ‘Allah is free of defects, the Lord of the prophets, the Holy Being of the Messengers and the Lord of the suppressed people (‘ A’immah from the family of the Holy Prophet) all praise belongs to Allah, Who gives life to the dead and He has power over all things,’
Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, will say, “My servant has spoken the truth and has thanked Me.’”
